> Intensity-based occupancy of every modification site in every run (or sample), from a table of MS/MS-identified peptidoforms with their per-run intensities, with the censoring state of each cell.

Wire verb `ptmqtl occupancy` · Python [`pymzlib.ptmqtl.occupancy`][pymzlib.ptmqtl.occupancy]

### Wraps

- [`SiteOccupancyCalculator.Calculate`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/cc67b7a2/mzLib/Quantification/PtmQtl/SiteOccupancy.cs) in `mzLib/Quantification/PtmQtl/SiteOccupancy.cs` at mzLib `cc67b7a2`
- [`PeptidoformObservation`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/d10017ce/mzLib/Quantification/PtmQtl/SiteOccupancy.cs) in `mzLib/Quantification/PtmQtl/SiteOccupancy.cs` at mzLib `d10017ce`

- [`ModificationSite`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/d10017ce/mzLib/Quantification/PtmQtl/SiteOccupancy.cs) in `mzLib/Quantification/PtmQtl/SiteOccupancy.cs` at mzLib `d10017ce`

### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `observations` | `path` | required | — | — | A TSV with a header row naming its columns, in any order, one row per (run, peptidoform, protein) identified by MS/MS: run; full_sequence, the peptidoform in MetaMorpheus notation (a modification as [Category:IdWithMotif] after its residue, a protein N-terminal one before the first residue); protein_accession; start_residue and end_residue, the peptide's first and last residue in the protein, 1-based; intensity, the peptidoform's MS/MS-quantified intensity in that run in instrument units (blank, NA or NaN means identified but not quantified); and optionally previous_residue, the protein residue before the peptide (one letter, blank when unknown). A peptide shared by several proteins is one row per protein. One row per PSM is refused, since it would count an intensity several times. A match-between-runs transfer must not be a row. A 0 intensity is read as quantified at zero, and adds nothing to either sum. Any other column is not read and is listed in ignored_columns. mzLib has no reader that builds this table from MetaMorpheus or FlashLFQ output; the pyMzLib ptmqtl guide shows how. |
| `samples` | `path` | absent | — | — | Optional. A TSV with a header row, then run, sample: two columns, one row per run. With it, each peptidoform's intensity is summed over a sample's runs before the ratio (mzLib's runToSample overload), and the run column of the result holds the sample. Every run of the observations must be listed; a run listed here but absent there is ignored, as mzLib ignores it. Map only fractions of one sample together, never technical replicates. Absent, the bridge sends none and occupancy is per run. |
| `modifications` | `string` | absent | — | `exact names, tab-separated, none blank` | Optional. Count only these modifications as sites: exact names as full_sequence writes them, Category:IdWithMotif, separated by tabs (a name holds spaces and commas, never a tab). mzLib's includeModification filter, applied after its own exclusions. Not with categories. Absent, the bridge sends no filter: every modification mzLib does not exclude is a site. |
| `categories` | `string` | absent | — | `category names, tab-separated, none blank` | Optional. Count only modifications of these categories, the text before the first ':' of the name (mzLib's ModificationSite.Category), for example Common Biological. Separated by tabs. Not with modifications. Absent, no filter. |
| `out` | `path` | absent | — | `.tsv only, any case (PYB-1)` | Write the table to this path as plain tab-separated text instead of returning columns: one header row (column_names), null as an empty cell, numbers in invariant culture at round-trip precision, booleans as true or false, nothing quoted. This is the file ptmqtl trait-effects reads as occupancy. Parent directories are created. Must differ from observations. Must end in .tsv, any case; any other extension, or none, is a usage error before any input is read. |

### Returns

Top-level fields:

| Field | Type | Unit | Null? | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `observations_file` | `string` | — | never | Absolute path of the observations table. |
| `samples_file` | `string` | — | yes: no --samples: occupancy is per run | Absolute path of the run-to-sample table. |
| `observation_count` | `int` | rows | never | Observation rows read. |
| `run_count` | `int` | runs | never | Distinct runs in the observations. |
| `sample_count` | `int` | samples | yes: no --samples | Distinct samples in the run-to-sample table. |
| `run_names` | `string[]` | — | never | The distinct values of the run column, in ordinal order: the runs, or with --samples the samples, that have at least one cell. |
| `site_count` | `int` | sites | never | Distinct sites (protein, position, modification) in the table. |
| `state_counts` | `map<string,int>` | cells | never | Cells per state: quantified, floor, count_only, not_detected. |
| `modifications` | `string[]` | — | yes: no --modifications filter | The modification names the sites were limited to. |
| `categories` | `string[]` | — | yes: no --categories filter | The categories the sites were limited to. |
| `ignored_columns` | `string[]` | — | never | Columns of the observations file that are not fields of mzLib's observation, so were not read; empty when every column was read. |
| `row_count` | `int` | rows | never | Cells in the table, whether returned or written. |
| `column_names` | `string[]` | — | never | The table's columns, in order; also the header --out writes. |
| `columns` | `table` | — | yes: the table was written to --out instead | One row per (site, run) where the site was identified or covered, in mzLib's order: by protein, then run, then position and modification. |
| `written` | `object` | — | yes: --out was not given | {path, format: tsv, row_count} of the file --out wrote. |
| `caveats` | `string[]` | — | never | Six static caveats; one more with --samples, one when columns were not read, and one counting the censored (floor or not_detected) cells when there are any. |

Per-row fields (one value per record, in `columns` or each list entry):

| Field | Type | Unit | Null? | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `site_key` | `string` | — | never | mzLib's ModificationSite.Key, accession:residue position:modification, for example P1:S13:Common Biological:Phosphorylation on S. The key ptmqtl pairs and ptmqtl trait-effects name sites by. |
| `protein_accession` | `string` | — | never | The protein the site is on, as given. |
| `position` | `int` | — | never | 1-based residue position in the protein. A protein N-terminal modification is at the residue it sits on (1, or 2 after the initiator Met is removed). readers read-occupancy counts differently (0 is the N-terminus): do not join the two on position. |
| `residue` | `string` | — | never | The one-letter residue at position. |
| `modification` | `string` | — | never | The modification as full_sequence names it, Category:IdWithMotif. |
| `category` | `string` | — | never | The text before the first ':' of modification (mzLib's ModificationSite.Category); empty when the name has none. |
| `run` | `string` | — | never | The run, or with --samples the sample. |
| `state` | `string` | — | never | quantified (the modified form was quantified: a fraction in (0, 1]) \| floor (the modified form was identified but not quantified while forms covering the site were: low but NOT zero) \| count_only (the modified form was identified, but nothing covering the site was quantified) \| not_detected (a covered-zero, mzLib's DEF-OCC-COVERED-ZERO: peptidoforms covering the site were identified in this run and none carried the modification; a bound below what the run could detect, not a measured 0; since mzLib #1468 the covering forms need not be quantified). |
| `modified_intensity` | `float` | intensity (instrument units) | never | Summed intensity of the quantified peptidoforms carrying this modification at this position; 0 unless state is quantified. |
| `covering_intensity` | `float` | intensity (instrument units) | never | Summed intensity of every quantified peptidoform covering the position, modified or not; 0 for count_only. |
| `fraction` | `float` | fraction (0 to 1) | yes: state is not quantified: the occupancy is censored (floor), a bound (not_detected) or unknown (count_only), never 0 | modified_intensity / covering_intensity. |
| `unmodified_quantified` | `bool` | — | never | Whether some quantified form covering the position does not carry this modification there (the unmodified form, or another modification at the same position). false with fraction 1 is a ceiling: the site was seen only modified. |

### Errors

| Kind | pyMzLib raises | When |
|---|---|---|
| `usage` | [`UsageError`][pymzlib.UsageError] | observations missing, blank or not found; samples given without a value or not found; out given without a value, not ending in .tsv, or the observations path; modifications and categories both given, either without a value or with a blank name |
| `usage` | [`UsageError`][pymzlib.UsageError] | the observations file empty, header-only, missing a required column, with a repeated column name, a row whose field count differs from its header, a start_residue or end_residue that is not an integer, an intensity that is not a number (other than blank, NA, NaN), or a previous_residue longer than one letter; the samples file without two fields per row, with a blank or repeated run |
| `usage` | [`UsageError`][pymzlib.UsageError] | mzLib refuses the observations, in its own words: an empty run, sequence or accession; start_residue below 1 or a span that does not fit the sequence's length; an infinite or negative intensity; one (run, peptidoform, protein, start) given twice; a run with no sample, or an empty sample |
| `correctness` | [`BridgeError`][pymzlib.BridgeError] | never expected |
| `service_unavailable` | [`ServiceUnavailableError`][pymzlib.ServiceUnavailableError] | never raised by this verb |

### Caveats

- Intensity occupancy, as MetaMorpheus writes IntensityOccupancy_ (QuantProject DEF-OCC-INT): for a site in a run, the summed intensity of the quantified peptidoforms carrying the modification at that position over the summed intensity of every quantified peptidoform covering it. Supply MS/MS identifications only: a match-between-runs transfer must not be a row.
- fraction is null unless state is quantified. A floor (identified, not quantified, while the site was covered) is low but not zero, and not_detected is a bound below detection: neither may be averaged in as 0.
- A fraction of 1 with unmodified_quantified false is a ceiling: the unmodified form may be present below detection.
- position is 1-based, with a protein N-terminal modification at the residue it sits on; readers read-occupancy puts the N-terminus at 0.
- mzLib always excludes the categories Common Variable and Common Fixed, peptide-terminal modifications, and every C-terminal modification (the protein's length is not supplied). An N-terminal modification is a site only on a peptide starting at residue 1, or at 2 when previous_residue is M or blank. Whether it is protein- or peptide-terminal is read from mzLib's modification registry; a name the registry does not know is treated as protein N-terminal.
- A peptide shared by several proteins counts in full for each; MetaMorpheus gives it a proportional share per protein group, so its IntensityOccupancy_ can differ.
- With samples, fractions are summed before the ratio. Map only fractions of one sample together; technical replicates keep their own run.

### Example

```python
result = pymzlib.ptmqtl.occupancy('cases.tsv')
```

Recorded from the live bridge as [`ptmqtl_occupancy_cases.json`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/pyMzLib/blob/main/pkg/python/tests/fixtures/ptmqtl_occupancy_cases.json). The doctests in the API reference replay these recordings in CI.

```python
result = pymzlib.ptmqtl.occupancy('fractions.tsv', samples='fractions_samples.tsv')
```

Recorded from the live bridge as [`ptmqtl_occupancy_fractions.json`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/pyMzLib/blob/main/pkg/python/tests/fixtures/ptmqtl_occupancy_fractions.json). The doctests in the API reference replay these recordings in CI.
